Definition: a lid (used only of the cover of the sacred Ark)
BiblicalUsage: Kapporeth is the mercy seat — the lid of gold over the ark, where the cherubim spread their wings and God met with Moses. Thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold; thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mercy seat is the most hopeful piece of furniture in the Bible. The law was inside the ark, the blood was sprinkled above it, and God met His people there — mercy above the law, and the meeting place is still open.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
